title: Future Juice Cherry & Lemonade Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Cherry & Lemonade is a refreshingly tangy blend that balances the deep, juicy sweetness of ripe Cherry with the fizzy zest of Lemonade. The bold Cherry flavour provides a rich, fruity base, while the Lemonade adds a bright, citrusy sparkle. This combination creates a lively and refreshing vape with layers of sweetness and tartness playing off one another in perfect harmony. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and punchy flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it brings a fruit-forward taste with a zesty finish. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
